summary.goal: Add a settings page for global preferences and connection management.

acceptance_criteria.description: Theme setting: Light / Dark / System with prefers-color-scheme respect
Status bar bubble timing: configurable (default blocking: 30s, normal: 15s, FYI: 8s)
Graduation threshold: configurable (default 65%), with note that Tuner adjusts over time
Cost visibility: toggle show/hide cost per step and per project
Execution defaults: max concurrent (default 5), timeout (default 300s), retries (default 3)
Relay connection: shows status, manual reconnect button
Project-specific settings (scope→repo mapping, execution policy) live on project entity, not here

observations: Settings page is straightforward — no complex state management, just localStorage persistence
Accessible from dashboard or any project via /settings route
The key distinction: global settings here, project-specific settings on the project entity (accessible via conversation or project settings sheet in future)
The graduation threshold is a good example of Tuner integration — starts at default, Tuner adjusts over time based on user behavior
Theme setting uses same pattern as planner-ui and ideation-ui (class-based dark mode + prefers-color-scheme)
Relay connection status and manual reconnect provide debugging affordance
questions: Should settings be synced to backend for multi-device consistency?
Do we need a reset to defaults button?
Should we show advanced/developer settings separately?

steps.title: Create SettingsPage with basic layout
steps.description: Create SettingsPage component at /settings route. Simple layout (not three-column — just centered content max-width). Sections: Appearance, Notifications, Ideation, Execution, Advanced. Copy settings page structure from planner-ui or create new. Use shadcn/ui components for form elements (Switch, Slider, Select).

steps.title: Implement theme setting
steps.description: Copy theme toggle pattern from planner-ui and ideation-ui. Three options: Light, Dark, System (with prefers-color-scheme media query). Store in localStorage as 'theme'. Apply by toggling .theme-light / .theme-dark class on document root. System option detects prefers-color-scheme and applies appropriate class. Default: System (zen garden is light by default but respects OS preference).

steps.title: Implement remaining settings
steps.description: Add settings: Status bar bubble timing (blocking: 30s, normal: 15s, FYI: 8s — three sliders), Graduation threshold (slider, default 65%, note: 'Tuner adjusts this over time'), Cost visibility (toggle, default hidden), Execution defaults (max concurrent: 5, timeout: 300s, retries: 3 — number inputs), Relay connection (status indicator, manual reconnect button — copy from planner-ui RelayContext connection status).

steps.title: Persist all settings to localStorage
steps.description: Create useSettings hook for reactivity. Store settings object in localStorage key 'tend-settings'. Load on app init (wrap in SettingsProvider at app root). Settings schema matches context.settings_schema. On change, update localStorage and notify React Context consumers. Copy localStorage persistence pattern from planner-ui (sidebar state, view mode).

architect.scope: global settings only, project-specific on project entity
architect.tuner_integration: graduation threshold as future Tuner-controlled value
architect.persistence: localStorage with useSettings hook for reactivity
